bio: This roadside family-run restaurant enjoys a certain reputation in this region, and deservedly so as it has been in business for over 40 years now! Home to a bar at the entrance and an attractive classic, contemporary-style dining room on the first floor, it focuses on top-quality fish and seafood dishes in which ingredients such as langoustines, prawns, lobster, scallops and razor clams take centre stage. The result is authentic Galician cuisine that is carefully prepared and full of flavour....
